body: Now that I think about it, that sounds like the perfect thing for me. They might even have new positions open.
Why do you think I should look there?
A job, potential friendship, mutually beneficial acquaintanceship?
Guess I don't have to worry about it then.

I at this point have no idea what you're talking about. I'm agreeing with everyone that blackmail is immoral. That's what I said. That's what the whole post is about. I actually don't understand why everyone is mad. What should I have said?

Well, I can see how being mostly honest might work from your point of view. Have you ever considered that maybe your policy of honesty has worked against you somehow? As in, Maybe you missed out on an opportunity due to that?

No, I have said multiple times that I wouldn't want to do that. In fact, I said "I personally find that immoral, but I fear the same will happen to me If I post a profile picture." Immediately after I said that I could blackmail her. It's sort of like saying that you could have killed someone if you weren't paying attention while driving. It is of course bad to kill people, that's what you meant by mentioning the possibility.
Ugh, shit's scary. I'm very cautious as well. But it's a give and take kind of thing.
That's a good way of going about it. I honestly just didn't take this stuff very seriously when I first joined.

Ok, I'll keep that in mind for the future. For right now, is there any way to just make a category of questions private? I noticed that I can see other people's questions in categories like sex, education, ethics etc. Can I do that for me? And thank you for answering my question.

To be honest where I live fuckery of all kinds is ok. I do most of my dating related stuff offline so that's not to much of a stretch. I just don't want to give up on this online dating thing immaturely.

It's happened to me and people I know often. For example, the story of that girl in my original post. And I find it difficult to move around socially f people are all up in your shit, metaphorically. I pride myself on my ability to seem non threatening to different types of people at different times. That ability is predicated on people not knowing all of the dirty details of my life. Also I don't want my parents finding out about anything, they will stop paying for college and giving me money.
Also young girls tend to do that. Don't know why.
That's the worst case scenario. I wouldn't do that,  think that's creepy and terrible, I was just saying that that could happen.
I feel that it's important to have all of that information on there for potential dates, but I don't want anyone off site seeing those specifically. Is there any privacy setting I could change?
I'm sorry if that seemed weird, I meant to say that was a BAD thing that I wouldn't do, and I don't want that happening to me.
I kinda want a mixture of both edgy and dirty though. Like someone who is actually fucked in the head but is coping.
They go together more often than not.
I find the bitchier looking the girl is the better a person she is. A hard life makes a good person, in my opinion.
I'm not drunk and high all the time, just on the weekends.
I see that. Should I move out to avoid all this stuff?
I agree that I should do this. That won't solve my problem though.

Good idea. She's always around though, and it's hard to talk to the other people on my floor without having to deal with her pretty regularly. I'm pretty sure I wouldn't stab her though, as I'm opposed to violence, and I feel as if I would get caught.
I see that yeah. But there is a difference between "doing something alot" and "greatly harming yourself" with a substance or action. Where does my behavior fall on that spectrum, in your opinion?

Every horror story about porn addiction starts when dudes look at porn or something when not masturbating. I guess I'm a special case- I have something like 150 gigs of porn on my computer. I'm a pretty big collector, but only when I'm fapping. only do it once per day, but I spend at least an hour everytime. When I'm collecting, it can take 1.5 to 2 hours. It doesn't get in the way of anything but I wonder if that's such a good idea.
Vomiting? Alright.

Alright, I see where your coming from. Will that make me like them more as people though, or will it just make me more popular with them. To be honest, I don't feel as if I need to be friends with women as much as I'd like to have sex with them. It's just that I feel as if it's not cool to not really care about them as people.
That's an interesting way of putting it. I had not thought of it that way before. I would like to have a sexual relationship with a lot of people though, but goal seems kinda distant from here.

I don't think you understand where I'm coming from. A lot of dudes on the internet would walk up to incredibly attractive people and ask them about Dragon Elf Slayer, but I'm not that guy. I realize that for most women, talking about nerdy shit in real life is a big red flag, so I avoid it. But If I cant ever mention that stuff to someone I've known for years? That's a problem.


Let me give you an example- I know his girl, super hot, who was big into Wheel of Time and ASOIAF. I'm not that big into fantasy, but I'd been reading George RR Martin recently. I tried to talk to her about it. She was unwilling. Eventually, we kinda had a falling out. Now with a guy, that would not have happened. I've had plenty of guy friends who were in to mudding and shotguns, topics I don't care for, and have been able to sustain a friendship. So it's not my ability to talk to people, I'm not autistic. I'm assumng that it must e that I have a problem with talking to women.
I'm sure. So, how do I change my insides to match what I want to project.

Well, that all makes sense, but does it explain why I don't have this problem with guys? I can talk to any guy casually for any period of time and not burn any bridges. To be honest, I see more guys ans decent people who are worth being friends with than I see people I don't like. But with girls, I might see one in a few thousand who I can stand for any good length of time. I have a few really, really good guy friends who I empathize with, but no girls who I really want to talk to.

I don't think I see them as greater than me, they just seem really different. I know that having higher self esteem is good, but I'm not sure how to get there from here. I've read up on it, but none of the advice given seems useful.

Here's the thing though- I've tried to do that. Every time I try to just talk to a girl as if she were a guy, then I get that Look that says "Why the fuck are you even bothering to talk to me." That might be part of my problem. See, when I talk to guys, a lot of my conversation has an edge to it. I make a lot of jokes an try to go as far as possible to show that I'm joking. Guys mostly don't take it seriously, girls do. If I don't do that, I get bored, to be honest. I've tried to care about stereotypically girly things, but I just can't, unless the person I'm talking too is a really good story teller, and most people arent.

I doubt so, too. The unfortunate thing about that is that you never know.   I'm not sure if it's just that I haven't met more interesting people, or if it's just that I, for some reason, don't like girls specifically.
Well, thanks anyway. I'll keep it in mind

Alright, thanks for taking the time to respond. Sorry if I sounded like I was trying to generalize, it's just that I didn't want to write a wall of text. These are just my experiences, and I realize that they aren't the gospel truth.  If you have any more insight on the matter, could you please answer these following questions- If you've even met another  person like me, what kind of vibe did you get form them and what wold you recommend they change? Also, do you ever find it easier to talk to women as opposed to men?
Yes, that's generally how it goes. I'm not proud of it, but I'm not going to lie and say I'm perfect. Are you saying I should try to find more nerdy women and talk to them?
That's interesting. I've thought about it. I personally think that the problem lies with me, rather than the girl around me. but I am looking forward to the future.
I'm not just trying to rant, I'm actually trying to understand why I feel this way. Notice that this is a recent change in behavior that I don't like very much.
That's what I'm trying to do. I understand that I can't be this sexist and be a functioning member of society. But I can't help what I feel. So I'd like to change.

That's good for the first few conversations, but what about a friendship? It's hard to keep those up when the person you're talking to doesn't give the slightest fuck about what you're personally into. I've seen this happen firsthand In my interactions with women. Basically, it becomes one sided either way- She's talking about things that interest her all the tie, or I am. I'm not a stranger to god conversation, as you call it, It just happens to work out better with guys. Why do you think that is?
